mentions.name: Auto OG Image Generator
mentions.description: This tool automatically generates Open Graph (OG) images for web pages by adding a single HTML meta tag, working as a set-and-forget solution that can be mixed with hand-built or Puppeteer-based OG images.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've started working on a tool to automatically generate OG images by just setting 1 line of a HTML meta tag.

evidence.value: I've started working on a tool to automatically generate OG images by just setting 1 line of a HTML meta tag.
